brief: Disclosures for Sorrento Therapeutics, Inc. trial NCT04903327 (COVI-MSC, phase 2, terminated; primary completion 2022-08-29, completion 2022-11-23). Find what Sorrento told investors in 8-Ks about this trial or COVI-MSC near when it stopped. Quote the 8-K language exactly and say whether it gives a reason.

findings.claim: Sorrento Therapeutics, Inc. filed Form 8-K on 2023-02-22 (accession 0001104659-23-023902) mentioning COVI-MSC in a trademark or pipeline list, and the excerpt gives no reason for trial termination.
findings.notes: Registry reason is enrollment, but SEC filings only mention the drug name in trademark listings or general pipeline descriptions without discussing trial status or giving a reason.
